newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums weaker, focus on Russian cargO.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums weaker, focus on Russian cargO.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums weakened on Thursday although a stronger futures market kept outright prices firm.
The focus of the physical market was Russian 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil cargoes, which traded three times at weaker premiums.
A trading house bought two cargoes at June IPE +$2.00 and one at June IPE +$2.25 a tonne cif ARA.
The cargoes were all 25,000 to 30,000 tonnes loading in the second half of May.
Trading was quiet on the FOD and DIN markets after a DIN cargo traded on Wednesday at June IPE +$5.75 a tonne cif Bremen.
Offers of heating oil barges dipped to June IPE +$2.00 a tonne fob ARA, with bids at $1.25.
Barge traders complained that German end-user buying was virtually non-existent.
June IPE gas oil closed $2.75 a tonne higher at $179.
